note: Sample validation evidence for Phase 1 ingestion build. Fetched via GET /api/fixtures/between?competitions=423&seasons=6484&from=1723507200&to=1730419200&include=stats (Premier League, 2024/25 season, Aug-Nov 2024 window). The raw web_fetch response was truncated by a tool-level save limit at ~82KB; 51 of the reported 90 fixtures were salvaged as complete, parseable JSON objects via bracket-depth extraction and used to validate the ingestion pipeline end-to-end (raw storage, normalization, SQLite upsert, dedup). No API token appears in this file or in any file the pipeline wrote.
new_finding: info.next_page_url can be the JSON boolean `false` (not only null or a URL string) when there is exactly one page. The client's pagination loop was already safe against this (short-circuit `and`), and a regression test was added to lock in the behavior.

validation_results.raw_storage_roundtrip: PASS - saved page reloads byte-identical to what was written
validation_results.normalization_missing_field_tracking: PASS - all 51 fixtures had >=1 explicitly-tracked missing field (elapsed_seconds/time_added/winning_team-on-draws/offsides-and-red-cards-when-zero-events are commonly null on real data; none were silently dropped)
validation_results.sqlite_dedup_reingest_same_batch: PASS - re-upserting the identical 51 records left the row count at 51 (no duplicates)
validation_results.sqlite_dedup_updated_content_same_id: PASS - upserting fixture 152908783 with a mutated home_goals value updated the existing row in place
validation_results.token_leak_check: PASS - token absent from raw JSON, normalized DB, and all log output after the api_client.py fix (see BUG_FOUND note in the final report)
